info.title: OPEX API (internal reference)
info.description:
Every HTTP route OPEX serves, generated from the route contracts in `apps/opex-api/src/**/contract.ts`.

Audiences:
- **Management API** (`/v1/manage/*`): the OPEX console. Cookie session + `X-CSRF-Token` on writes; roles viewer < auditor < operator < super_admin (auditors never write); sensitive actions need a fresh authenticator step-up.
- **Delivery API** (`/v1/delivery/*`): the website's server, with `DELIVERY_TOKEN`.
- **Partner API** and **OAuth**: AraCMS (see the partner reference).
- **Render API** (`/v1/render/*`): the 3D renderer, with `RENDER_TOKEN`.
- **Operations**: health, readiness, metrics, public media.

Personal data (tickets, form answers) is encrypted at rest and never written to the audit log.

**Errors** are RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` with a stable `code` (the OAuth token endpoint uses RFC 6749 errors instead). Validation errors list `issues` (path + message). Every answer carries `X-Request-Id`; quote it when reporting a problem.

**Rate limits** default to 600 requests per minute per IP; routes that differ say so. Over the limit: 429 `RATE_LIMITED` with `Retry-After`.

**Timestamps** are ISO 8601 UTC. **Ids** are prefixed ULIDs (`cr_`, `ast_`, `rev_`, `tkt_`…): sortable by creation time.

post.summary: Get tokens (authorization_code, refresh_token, client_credentials)
post.description:
Client authentication is private_key_jwt only (`client_assertion_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:client-assertion-type:jwt-bearer`, ES256, aud = this URL, single-use jti). Every request needs a `DPoP` proof header; tokens are bound to that key. Errors follow RFC 6749 (`error`, `error_description`), not problem+json.

**Rate limit:** 60 per minute per IP.

**Audit:** records `oauth.token.issued`, `oauth.token.refreshed`, `oauth.token.failure`, `oauth.refresh.reuse_detected`.

**Source:** `apps/opex-api/src/oauth/routes.ts`

post.summary: Submit a form (becomes a helpdesk ticket)
post.description:
Sent by the website's server (/api/forms/{slug}) with the visitor's IP in `X-End-User-IP`. Answers are validated against the published definition: unknown fields are refused and fields hidden by a condition are dropped. Files travel base64 in `files` (max 10 MB each, 5 in all, kinds allowed by the field, virus-scanned). Personal data is stored encrypted; the audit log never holds it. A sender blocked as spam gets 202 and nothing is stored. The P8 body shape (`subject`, `spec`, `fields`) is still accepted.

**Rate limit:** 120 per minute per IP, plus the form's own per-visitor limit per 10 minutes.

**Audit:** records `ticket.created`.

**Source:** `apps/opex-api/src/forms/routes.ts`

`VALIDATION_FAILED`: The request does not match the schema; `issues` lists each field.

`UNKNOWN_FORM`: No published form with this slug.

`INVALID_SUBMISSION`: Some answers fail the form's rules; `issues` gives each field id and a code: required, invalid_email, invalid_phone, invalid_option, too_long, too_short, too_small, too_large, pattern, invalid_number, invalid_date, too_many_files, bad_file, unknown_field.

`BAD_TOKEN`: Wrong token.

`CHALLENGE_FAILED`: TURNSTILE_SECRET is set and the token is missing or invalid.

post.summary: Import Arapoush size charts into the tube catalogue
post.description:
Reads one or more size charts (.xlsx, one cross-section per file) and applies them to the current draft of `product.tube.catalogue`: sizes and volumes per diameter, which closures fit, and the colour families each closure comes in. Closures are matched by id, Persian name or `aliases`; unknown ones are added with a warning. Without `apply` it only previews (the changes against the draft). With `apply` it saves a new draft revision, which is published the normal way.

**Console role:** operator or above.

**Audit:** records `content.revision.create`.

**Source:** `apps/opex-api/src/catalogue/routes.ts`

apply.description: false: preview only. true: save the result as a new draft.

200.description: Preview (or saved draft) with what the charts change.
